outcome: Maternal complications (anemia, wound infections, respiratory tract infections)
cohort: Antenatal mothers diagnosed with HIV during pregnancy or before, delivering at North Bengal Medical College & Hospital between March 2021 and February 2022.
finding: HIV infection during pregnancy increases the risk of low birth weight and preterm birth.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries for HIV-positive mothers were via emergency cesarean section (56.7%).
